verdict.rationale: Motion's docs explicitly describe daily meeting limits that make the calendar unbookable once the threshold is reached, which covers the daily booking cap. They also describe setting ideal meeting windows and custom availability, but these are time-of-day or weekday preferences rather than clearly bounded date-range booking windows. Missing for 10: buffers before/after meetings, minimum-notice settings, explicit date-range booking windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
